'''Alveoli Blocks''' are infested blocks that require [[Bronchial Tube|Bronchial Tubes]] to function.
{{Item Info
|image1=Alveoli Block.png
|id=srparasites:alveoli
}}

==''Obtainment''==
Alveoli Blocks are not directly craftable, but can be found as "tree" leaves in the [[Harlequin Biome]], or within the [[Meteor]] structure.

{{CraftingTable|r1_b2=Solid Alveoli Block|r1_output=Alveoli Block|r1_count=2|r1_shapeless=true}}

==''Usage''==
Glass Bottles can be used on Alveoli Blocks to harvest [[Alveolar Fluid]]. If one is not in contact with a Bronchial Tube, it will turn into a Sick Alveoli Block and become unusable. 

Two can be used to create the less transparent Solid Alveoli Block.
{{CraftingTable|r1_a1=Alveoli Block|r1_b1=Alveoli Block|r1_output=Solid Alveoli Block|r1_shapeless=true|r1_nolink=true}}
